A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ViT representation-understanding study. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices are readable and matchable despite pagination and section-number changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation and semantic-correspondence experiments across models, layers, and sizes, together with appendix sensitivity analyses and LayerNorm ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and reports revised Cityscapes results and additional qualitative outputs in Figure 13.

M1.justification: The frozen-embedding, PCA-initialized online k-means procedure, cosine assignment, upsampling, Hungarian matching, and visualization workflow remain unchanged. Expanded documentation of attention mutual information does not establish a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate segmentation on COCO-Stuff-27, PascalPart animals, and Cityscapes, plus semantic correspondence on SPair-71k. The additional Figure 13 examples remain within existing dataset and task coverage.

E2.justification: The eight SSL frameworks and supervised ViT/OpenCLIP baselines remain. Figure 13 adds qualitative displays for models already included in its numerical comparison; it does not introduce newly evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: v1 A.6 assigns PascalPart and Cityscapes the A.2 settings, including learning rate 0.005. v2 A.7 instead reports a grid-searched rate of 0.0002 for both. This revises the reported protocol, without establishing whether experiments were rerun or earlier settings were misreported.

E4.justification: Figure 13 extends the positional-bias case analysis with Cityscapes segmentation and aggregate maps, additional PascalPart examples, and further model visualizations. Existing initialization, batch-size, overclustering, correspondence-failure, and LayerNorm analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v2 Section 3.3 explicitly reports p < .001 for the two correlations, whereas v1 Figure 8 uses unexplained 'p***' annotations. This clarifies significance reporting; the correlation coefficients remain unchanged, and no additional runs or new tests are established.

E6.justification: Figure 13 revises Cityscapes NMI and mIoU bars; for example, iBOT NMI changes from approximately 0.83 to 0.72. It also adds qualitative outputs. These accompany a revised reported learning rate, so they are not established same-setting improvements. Tables 3–5 retain their numerical entries.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.3 extends v1's brief MI formula with explicit uniform-query and image/head-weighting assumptions, derives the joint and marginal distributions and conditional-MI estimator, and explains the zero-MI case. This adds a localized mathematical derivation without changing the main algorithm.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: an interpretable segmentation-based probing protocol, positional effects as an upstream cause of locality bias, and positional effects as a proposed explanation for DINOv3 inverse scaling.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly characterizes attention MI as a proxy for locality bias. A.11 also adds an interpretation of the retained Figure 18, attributing larger DINO-family models' correspondence behavior to more focused, fine-grained activations. Existing confounding and mixed-patch limitations remain.

D1.justification: A.3 newly documents CLS-token exclusion, attention-row renormalization, and averaging over images and heads. A.7 explains whole-training-set PCA initialization for the small PascalPart subset and learning-rate selection. The code-access link remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Rossetti and Pirri's hierarchy-agnostic unsupervised segmentation work to support the discussion of fine-grained semantics missed by standard benchmarks. Other bibliography changes largely update existing references rather than alter research positioning.

P1.justification: The main exposition is extensively tightened through sentence and paragraph rewrites across the introduction, protocol, results, discussion, and conclusion. v2 also numbers discussion themes, inserts a dedicated MI appendix subsection, updates author and affiliation information, and adds acknowledgments.

P2.justification: Figure 13 is expanded and rearranged, Figure 2 is redrawn, and several figures receive clearer metric labels or styling. Figure 9 corrects 'BS16' to 'BS24', matching the existing text. Table captions move above tables, with associated page reflow; the overall visual organization remains recognizable.

improvement.justification: The explicit MI construction, clearer experimental documentation, expanded Figure 13, and corrected labels improve transparency and interpretability. Prose tightening also helps readability. The main claims and most evidence remain unchanged, and revised Cityscapes scores accompany different reported settings, so the gains support a limited overall improvement rather than stronger performance conclusions.
